title: Jayla Mullard
content:
'''Family:''' [[Longspears]]. Jayla is the great-granddaughter of [[Egil Longspear]] on her mother's side.

A fierce young woman rumored to be the disowned daughter of [[Crossbow Henry]]. A regular at the [[Sundial Inn]].
==Connection==
*[[Ledo]] is planning to kill all descendents of Egil Longspear.
